entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.comment:
This reduced rate applies only to chronic ulcers and pressure sores (part 1):
— gels, hydrocolloidal gels, hydrocolloidal pastes, rinsing solutions for chronic ulcers containing undecylenamidepropylbetanine; 3003 90 00, 3004 90 00, 3005 90 99, 3401 30 00, 3808 94 90
— Hydrogel wound pads; 3005 90 99
— wound poultices, with salt crystals; 3005 90 50
— alginate dressings, calcium alginate dressings; 3005 90 50, 3005 90 99 
— Hydrofibre wound dressings; 3005 90 50
